basis: Measured Phase 0 source replay, public comparison and local gate/HTTP tests; no sealed evaluation or production proof
ranking_method: Qualitative priority: safety first, portability next, then falsifiable acceleration and UX/context value. Not a measured ROI ranking.

missions.mission: Independent ambiguity, authorization and candidate referee
missions.gap: 758 wrong-but-READY Run A extra cases; original diagnostic flag does not block execution. Candidate code execution remains blocked.
missions.value: Prevent semantic uncertainty or transport metadata from authorizing effects; make other computers safely comparable.
missions.independence: Start now from frozen raw sources and public vectors; separate evaluator custody from candidate builders.
missions.competition: Ambitious alternative: a small state-machine/model-checking referee plus disposable OS sandbox instead of another parser-focused red team. Compare with adversarial property tests.
missions.experiment: Implement isolated data/command intake and model the preview→permit→receipt state transitions; attempt corruption, timeout, concurrent replay and reject-everything candidates.
missions.acceptance: Zero unauthorized receipts across at least 100 preregistered mutation schedules; every seeded fault caught; valid controls execute exactly once; untrusted runner cannot read a mounted secret sentinel or use network.

effort.method: One isolated runner + state model + roughly six fault strata; excludes third-party security audit

missions.risk: False confidence from public tests; sandbox escape or holdout leakage.
missions.friction: Medium: requires OS isolation capability and agreed wire contract.
unknowns: Available sandbox substrates on five computers
missions.reallocate_if: If isolated execution cannot be deployed, keep grading data-only and prioritize an external referee environment.

missions.mission: Portable semantic compiler with independent differential proof
missions.gap: Working core is Python; TypeScript only covers the browser. Partial provenance and grammar evolution remain unproved.
missions.value: An SDK usable in the Windows/browser stack with source-bound deterministic readings and reproducible semantics.
missions.independence: Can begin from frozen goldens immediately; never wait for C2 to invent the whole runtime.
missions.competition: Ambitious alternative: generate a language-neutral IR and parser tables from declarations, emitting TS or WASM, versus hand-porting the Python interpreter.
missions.experiment: Port six capabilities behind interpret/render/parseReading; compare byte-exact results and digests against the fixture and all reachable states; measure registry and input-length growth.
missions.acceptance: 179 public vectors and 417 state readings match, all 70,101 generated rows receive separately reported fidelity/ambiguity results, no additional unflagged false READY, Unicode rejection agrees across runtimes. Preserve all known failures instead of training them away silently.

effort.method: Compiler/recognizer port + renderer inverse + cross-runtime fixtures, not full production SDK

missions.risk: Replicating original parser bugs; claiming stronger grammar coverage than observed.
missions.friction: Medium: explicit adapter schemas and canonical encoding are available; existing internal state shapes need normalization.
unknowns: Whether full source spans can be retained economically
missions.reallocate_if: If table-driven generation materially reduces mutation cost with equivalent safety, prioritize IR over a line-for-line port.

missions.mission: Declaration evolution and a credible B4 conventional twin
missions.gap: Six-capability independent checker is hard-coded; no proof declarations make correct changes cheaper. compileHelp is absent.
missions.value: Test the central development acceleration claim before expanding the semantic platform.
missions.independence: Use current Python twin now; future TS twin equivalence is a comparison gate, not a prerequisite to drafting blinded tasks.
missions.competition: Ambitious alternative: typed TS capability objects with generated reflection and property tests instead of a bespoke DSL. Include source-to-capsule compilation as an optional third arm.
missions.experiment: Build a conventional behavior-equivalent twin independently, then run preregistered changes: add capability, rename entity, change consequence, fix bug, update model compatibility.
missions.acceptance: Twins pass the same frozen behavior suite before comparison; at least five repeats per task per arm with matched model/budget; zero escaped authorization regressions; report tokens only with real counters and report a loss honestly.

effort.method: Two implementations, five task categories, instrumentation and repeated trials; dependent on model access

missions.risk: Biased tasks and unequal implementation quality manufacture acceleration.
missions.friction: High: evaluator extensions must be independent, and new declarations must not silently change the frozen fixture.
unknowns: Real token counters in Z.ai sessions
Independent twin quality and reviewer availability
missions.reallocate_if: If conventional typed declarations win, retain source-grounded contracts but drop the custom DSL as a requirement.

missions.mission: Ambiguity-first command UI and human comprehension
missions.gap: Loopback flow passes; browser rendering, Windows runtime, accessibility and human understanding are unverified. Many generated inputs are flagged ambiguous.
missions.value: Make account selection, exact payload and consequences understandable with minimal correction steps.
missions.independence: Use current bridge and mock snapshot; no real provider or finalized core port required.
missions.competition: Ambitious alternative: structured editable sentence chips plus live alternative-meaning previews, compared with free text and a single confirmation card.
missions.experiment: Run browser automation and Windows installation first; then compare text-card versus structured choice UX on account/payload-boundary cases with consenting human participants.
missions.acceptance: All dispatch-blocking tests remain green; keyboard-only completion and narrow viewport pass; no confirmation survives edits; preregister human error/correction measures and report denominator and uncertainty. No comprehension claim without people.
negative_controls: Ambiguity shown as warning with active confirm

effort.method: Two UI variants + browser/Windows checks + small participant study; recruitment excluded

missions.risk: Decorative UI masks incomplete semantics; opaque alternatives overwhelm users.
missions.friction: Low to medium: existing local endpoints work; choice flow supports only complete single-account partials.
missions.reallocate_if: If structured editing reduces errors substantially, favor it over expanding unrestricted parsing.

missions.mission: Source-fresh context and lossless handoff economics
missions.gap: No B2/B3 execution, no generated help/capsules, no measured relay overhead or token savings. Transport must not carry authority.
missions.value: Let later agents consume the source faithfully and cheaply while keeping current-state execution checks local.
missions.independence: Starts from current source hashes and public vectors; use local synthetic relays until external experiments are separately authorized.
missions.competition: Ambitious alternative: a content-addressed source graph queried by grep/code mode with a simple JSON envelope, versus compiled capsules plus A2A extension. Do not assume A2A is necessary.
missions.experiment: Answer a blinded mixed source question bank before/after mutations using grep, whole-file, vector and capsule arms; separately pass identical commands through native JSON versus typed envelope hops with injected faults.
missions.acceptance: Zero stale answers on declared source-mutation safety subset, 100% detection of seeded digest/basis faults, valid control acceptance, true token/wall-time/build-refresh costs; no authority accepted from envelope alone. B2/B3 wins require matched full arms.
negative_controls: Old capsule hash with new code

effort.method: Four retrieval arms, mutation questions, two relay transports and counters; embedding/model provisioning excluded

missions.risk: Combining context and relay work grows scope; token measurement may be unavailable.
missions.friction: Medium: identities exist but source-grounded help is absent; split into two bounded experiments inside the one computer.
unknowns: Meaning-preserving relay metrics with real models
missions.reallocate_if: If context retrieval dominates the bottleneck, defer A2A and use simple envelopes until a transport advantage is measured.
